name: Argo CD
description: Let agents read your Argo CD applications: whether each is synced and healthy, what was last deployed, the Kubernetes resources behind it and their recent events. For release checks and failed deployment triage.
identity: An Argo CD local account that can only sign in with an API token, bound to a read-only role.

setup.title: Create a read-only account for agents
setup.body: Argo CD accounts and roles live in its argocd-cm and argocd-rbac-cm ConfigMaps. The first command adds a local account that can only use API tokens. The second opens argocd-rbac-cm: under data, add the line g, ai-agents, role:readonly to policy.csv to give it the built-in read-only role. To keep it to some Argo CD projects instead, bind it to a role that may only get applications in those projects, such as p, role:agents, applications, get, payments/*, allow.
copy: kubectl -n argocd patch configmap argocd-cm --type merge -p '{"data":{"accounts.ai-agents":"apiKey"}}'

setup.title: Create an API token for the account
setup.body: Sign in to the argocd command line as an admin and create a token for the account. You can test the token with the curl line: it shows the account's name and changes nothing.

fields.label: Argo CD address
fields.help: The host name of your Argo CD, such as argocd.example.com, without https://.

capabilities.label: Read applications
capabilities.description: List applications with their sync and health status, read one application, its resource tree, its Kubernetes events and the commit behind a deployed revision. Lists projects.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Reaches every application the account's role allows unless you keep a key to chosen projects.

limits.label: Argo CD projects
limits.help: Optional: only applications in these Argo CD projects. Leave empty for every project the account can read.

revoke: Delete the account's token with argocd account delete-token --account ai-agents <token id>, or remove the accounts.ai-agents line from argocd-cm. Agents lose access to Argo CD at once.

tools.name: argocd_list_applications
tools.description: List applications with their project, destination, sync status, health and last operation.

projects.description: Only applications in these Argo CD projects

selector.description: A Kubernetes label selector, such as team=payments

repo.description: Only applications deployed from this Git repository address

tools.name: argocd_get_application
tools.description: Read one application: where it deploys from and to, its sync and health status, conditions such as errors, the last sync operation and the deployment history.

tools.name: argocd_get_resource_tree
tools.description: List the Kubernetes resources an application manages, with each one's health, to find what is failing.

project.description: The application's Argo CD project; Argo CD answers not found when the application is in another

tools.name: argocd_list_events
tools.description: List recent Kubernetes events for an application, or for one of its resources, such as failed pulls or crash loops.

project.description: The application's Argo CD project; Argo CD answers not found when the application is in another

resource_name.description: Only events for this resource name
resource_name.name: resourceName

tools.name: argocd_get_revision_metadata
tools.description: Read the commit behind a deployed revision: author, date, message and tags.

revision.description: The revision, such as status.sync.revision of the application

project.description: The application's Argo CD project; Argo CD answers not found when the application is in another
